findings: VisibilityModifier.ensureEven, size-minus-four circle/square and size-minus-two polygon formulas justify the changed glyph constants. The odd-size protocol control passes.

The 22px struct case gets individual glyph dimensions right but places later rows too early: MethodsOrFieldsArea.getLayout and PlacementStrategyVisibility use each measured block's height; Rust's fixed text-row advance does not retain the larger icon block height. The 3px case emits a negative-size square that Java's SVG rectangle driver suppresses. Neither failure is fixed by the new even-size primitive geometry.
bounded_repair_guidance: Use per-row max(icon block,text) dimensions and the SVG primitive driver's nonpositive-size behavior; keep requested block size distinct from even glyph size.
